_comment: classifieds authorization. A public catalog: anyone (role 'anon') may browse (list/get) the taxonomy, geo, and listings; posting/editing needs a logged-in 'user'; the catalog (category/category_attribute/geo) is admin-curated. Roles are matched exactly (no wildcard), so read actions list both 'anon' and 'user' (admin is a superuser and bypasses). listing_facet is an internal derived index — no direct client access (queries read it server-side). self_register is on for early testing; gate it for production.
